content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the requirement to hold a global lock (struct_mutex) for accessing a temporary link (dfs_link) within the i915_dependency structure during the execlists scheduling operation. This led to contention issues as not all callers needed to acquire the highly contended global lock, which could degrade performance and cause potential deadlocks. The patch introduces a local mutex to allow for exclusive access to the dfs_link without requiring the global lock, thus improving efficiency and reducing contention.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the requirement to hold a global lock (struct_mutex) for accessing a temporary link (dfs_link) within the i915_dependency structure during the execlists scheduling operation. This led to contention issues as not all callers needed to acquire the highly contended global lock, which could degrade performance and cause potential deadlocks. The patch introduces a local mutex to allow for exclusive access to the dfs_link without requiring the global lock, thus improving efficiency and reducing contention.
Patch:
From 27745e829a5cb896249f355f5bdab3249c5455e2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Chris Wilson <chris@chris-wilson.co.uk>
Date: Wed, 16 Nov 2016 15:27:21 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/execlists: Use a local lock for dfs_link access

Avoid requiring struct_mutex for exclusive access to the temporary
dfs_link inside the i915_dependency as not all callers may want to touch
struct_mutex. So rather than force them to take a highly contended
lock, introduce a local lock for the execlists schedule operation.

Reported-by: David Weinehall <david.weinehall@linux.intel.com>
Fixes: 9a151987d709 ("drm/i915: Add execution priority boosting for mmioflips")
Signed-off-by: Chris Wilson <chris@chris-wilson.co.uk>
Cc: Tvrtko Ursulin <tvrtko.ursulin@intel.com>
Cc: David Weinehall <david.weinehall@linux.intel.com>
Link: http://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20161116152721.11053-1-chris@chris-wilson.co.uk
Reviewed-by: Tvrtko Ursulin <tvrtko.ursulin@intel.com>
---
 drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_lrc.c | 7 +++++--
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_lrc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_lrc.c
index f50feaa7116a..43526814e042 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_lrc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_lrc.c
@@ -694,6 +694,7 @@ pt_lock_engine(struct i915_priotree *pt, struct intel_engine_cs *locked)
 
 static void execlists_schedule(struct drm_i915_gem_request *request, int prio)
 {
+	static DEFINE_MUTEX(lock);
 	struct intel_engine_cs *engine = NULL;
 	struct i915_dependency *dep, *p;
 	struct i915_dependency stack;
@@ -702,8 +703,8 @@ static void execlists_schedule(struct drm_i915_gem_request *request, int prio)
 	if (prio <= READ_ONCE(request->priotree.priority))
 		return;
 
-	/* Need BKL in order to use the temporary link inside i915_dependency */
-	lockdep_assert_held(&request->i915->drm.struct_mutex);
+	/* Need global lock to use the temporary link inside i915_dependency */
+	mutex_lock(&lock);
 
 	stack.signaler = &request->priotree;
 	list_add(&stack.dfs_link, &dfs);
@@ -770,6 +771,8 @@ static void execlists_schedule(struct drm_i915_gem_request *request, int prio)
 	if (engine)
 		spin_unlock_irq(&engine->timeline->lock);
 
+	mutex_unlock(&lock);
+
 	/* XXX Do we need to preempt to make room for us and our deps? */
 }
 
--
